full_judgment: 2. It. appears that the plaintiff-opposite party instituted a suit for declaration of his title and for recovery of khas possession on 16-6-73. Thereafter, the suit was fixed for peremptory hearing on. 39-3-74 which was shifted to 28-6-74. It appears that the suit was thereafter taken out of the peremptory list on the prayer of the plaintiff for appointment of an Advocate Commissioner for local investigation. The report of the Advocate Commissioner was however, rejected on the objection filed by the plaintiff and thereafter another Advocate Commissioner has been appointed for local investigation whose report has not yet been submitted. In 'the meanwhile, the defendant filed an application under Order 7, rule 11 of the Code for rejection of the plaint on the ground that there was no cause of action and that it was barred under the law. The learned Subordinate Judge negative both the contentions and rejected the application whereupon a revisional application was preferred which was dismissed by the learned Additional District Judge who affirmed the order of the learned Sub-ordinate Judge by an elaborate judgment. Hence the present Rule at the instance of the defendant;
